query: dengue Brasil 2024 boletim epidemiológico casos óbitos Ministério da Saúde SVS janeiro fevereiro março
query_rationale: Portuguese is the primary language of Brazilian official health publications. Targeting MoH/SVS bulletin terminology ('boletim epidemiológico', 'casos', 'óbitos') with month names for Q1 2024 maximises retrieval of the highest-authority source for all target fields including subnational breakdowns.
expected_source_type_or_evidence: Brazilian Ministry of Health (Ministério da Saúde) or SVS weekly epidemiological bulletin (Boletim Epidemiológico) with national and state-level dengue case and death counts for Q1 2024
expected_trust_signal: gov.br domain, SVS authorship, official bulletin numbering, SINAN/InfoDengue data citation

query: PAHO WHO dengue Brazil 2024 situation report cases deaths Q1 outbreak
query_rationale: PAHO is the primary international body monitoring dengue in the Americas and regularly publishes situation reports with Brazil-specific data. This provides cross-validation of Brazilian MoH figures and may include hospitalization and case-classification breakdowns.
expected_source_type_or_evidence: PAHO (Pan American Health Organization) or WHO epidemiological alert, situation report, or regional dengue update covering Brazil Q1 2024 with cumulative case and death counts
expected_trust_signal: paho.int or who.int domain, official situation report or epidemiological alert document, dated 2024
